postdocText: If you have an idea for a postdoc project on predation resistance, microbial evolution, or host-microbe interactions, get in touch — I'm happy to collaboratively develop a proposal for postdoc funding.
gradText: If you're interested in joining the lab, reach out with your research interests, experience, and a CV. All prospective graduate students should plan on applying for graduate fellowships — they help fund your tuition and stipend, strengthen your CV, and give you more time for research. Consider:
undergradText: Texas Tech undergraduates interested in joining the lab should email me directly. Please be ready to send a CV and a short description of your research interests.
